name: The Foschini Group Limited
summary: The Foschini Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates retail stores in South Africa and internationally. The company operates through TFG Africa, TFG London, and TFG Australia segments. It provides clothing, leisurewear, accessories, lingerie, footwear, cosmetics, fine jewellery, furniture, Homeware and furniture, sporting apparel, and kidswear.
